sections.heading: Kalash Bash Recap
paragraphs: To everyone who stopped by our booth at Kalash Bash — whether you came out to run our Diablo FRT on the range, pick up some gear, or just chop it up with the team — we want you to know we genuinely appreciated every single one of you. This was our first year at Kalash Bash, and we couldn’t have asked for a better welcome. You all showed up, you showed out, and it meant everything to us.

A massive shoutout to the event organizers and staff — y’all put on an absolutely incredible show. We were treated like family from start to finish, and that doesn’t go unnoticed. The work you put into making this event run smooth is something else. Thank you.
